offers_products.reason: Revenue comes mainly from renting equipment; sales of used equipment and supplies are incidental.

offers_services.reason: Equipment rental with delivery, pickup, 24/7 emergency service calls and safety training; rentals are leases of assets.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Customers are contractors, industrial, utility, entertainment and institutional businesses; individuals are not a main buyer.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Rents to contractors, utilities, manufacturers, healthcare facilities, schools, data centers and entertainment productions.

recurring_revenue.reason: Contractors and industrial customers rent repeatedly on daily, weekly and monthly terms; rental is lease-like repeat revenue.

cyclical_demand.reason: Rental demand tied to construction and industrial projects; customers can postpone projects and cut rentals in downturns.

big_ticket.reason: Daily, weekly or monthly equipment rentals are small, frequent transactions compared with buying machinery.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay mainly for access to the rental equipment fleet, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Serves a broad mix of contractors, industrial, entertainment and facility customers, many small to mid-sized, plus some utilities and large projects.

asset_heavy.reason: Large rental fleet of aerial, earthmoving, power and heavy equipment across many branches requires ongoing fleet capital investment.

notes: Herc is an equipment rental company; sells some used equipment and ancillary items, but rentals dominate. Large-customer answer is a judgment call.
